verification_method: PARTIAL - the peer-reviewed paper's Methods/Data-Availability text was directly fetched and read this sprint. Direct browsing of the actual Zenodo raw files was BLOCKED this sprint by a network-egress timeout to zenodo.org (two independent attempts, ~15-20s each, same failure mode as GalaxyPPG). This audit therefore relies on the paper's own reported subject/stage/acquisition facts rather than this session's own file listing/hashing.

public_vs_paper_cohort_reconciliation.exclusion_reason_from_paper: Two subjects had impedance instrumentation issues and were excluded.
public_vs_paper_cohort_reconciliation.resolution: This project's Stage-2 eligibility table must use 16 as the analyzable cohort, NOT 18 - per Section 13's explicit instruction not to silently borrow the paper's enrollment count. This is recorded as the frozen eligibility number below.
public_vs_paper_cohort_reconciliation.further_caveat: Whether the publicly-released Zenodo dataset itself contains exactly 16 subjects' worth of usable files (vs. 18 files with 2 flagged unusable, or some other structure) could NOT be confirmed this sprint (Zenodo access blocked). FLAGGED as a mandatory first Stage-2 step: open the actual Zenodo record and confirm which of the 16-vs-18 subjects' raw files are actually present before finalizing any eligibility table.

lbnp_pressure_levels.note: The master prompt's example levels (0/15/30/45/60) are a SUBSET of the actual full protocol (which goes to 100 mmHg) - directly corrected via the paper text, not assumed.
lbnp_pressure_levels.stage_duration: approximately 5 minutes stable per level, with ~48-second transition periods between levels
lbnp_pressure_levels.analysis_focus_in_paper: 0-60 mmHg specifically, to emphasize clinically occult (pre-symptomatic) states - this project's frozen target range should match this focus unless a reason to diverge is documented.

eis_acquisition.temporal_acquisition_cadence: approximately 1 full spectrum per minute, per anatomical site
eis_acquisition.spectra_type: per-stage measurements (roughly up to 5 per ~5-minute stage), not a continuously-sampled waveform
eis_acquisition.site_selected_for_this_experiment: thorax only (per Section 13's single-site focus, to keep A/B/C a single-variable comparison)

other_signals.ecg_pleth: Captured via LabChart 7.0; specific sample rates NOT stated in the retrieved text - UNVERIFIED, flagged for Stage-2 direct-file confirmation.
other_signals.map: Invasively measured via brachial arterial line; sample rate UNVERIFIED.
other_signals.eit: Continuous collection via dual 16-electrode belts (chest below nipple line, abdomen); frame rate UNVERIFIED. EIT is a DISTINCT modality from EIS and is out of scope for the frozen A/B/C (would violate the single-variable-at-a-time rule if mixed with EIS).

eligibility.rule: Require ECG, pleth, and thoracic EIS present and the subject not among the 2 impedance-instrumentation-excluded subjects
eligibility.verification_status: PARTIAL - based on the paper's own stated final-analysis cohort, not this session's direct file check (blocked). Stage-2 must re-verify against the actual Zenodo file set before training.
